description: AICTIONBOT™ price reduction claim by KULIC Advisory (tool 61). The reverse of check_price_increase. Takes a category (call list_categories for the codes), the month of the last price agreement and optionally the annual volume. Compares the official Eurostat producer or service price index for Germany (and labour costs for services) between then and now. If the market has fallen by 1 percent or more it returns the claim in percent and euros per year, a ready message to the supplier, the three objections to expect and the next step. If the market has not fallen it says so plainly: no claim from the index. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. The index measures the market in Germany, not the supplier's own costs. Not legal advice. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

annual_volume_eur.description: Optional: annual purchasing volume with this supplier in euros.

category.description: Category code or name from list_categories, for example C17 for paper and packaging.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

last_agreement.description: Month of the last price agreement as YYYY-MM, from 2019-01.

supplier.description: Optional: supplier name for the message.

name: claim_price_reduction
title: Claim a price reduction: has the market fallen since the last price agreement? Official Eurostat index, claim in percent and euros, ready message to the supplier
